abstract.text: The font attribute group gathers together attributes for determining the font within a credit or direction.
They are based on the text styles for Cascading Style Sheets. The font-family is a comma-separated list of
font names. The font-style can be normal or italic. The font-size can be one of the CSS sizes or a numeric
point size. The font-weight can be normal or bold. The default is application-dependent, but is a text font
vs. a music font.

The group-name-text attribute group is used by the group-name and group-abbreviation elements. The print-style
and justify attribute groups are deprecated in MusicXML 2.0 in favor of the new group-name-display and group-
abbreviation-display elements.
A MusicXML parser, normalizer, validator, and formatter.
The group-name type describes the name or abbreviation of a part-group element. Formatting attributes in the
group-name type are deprecated in Version 2.0 in favor of the new group-name-display and group-abbreviation-
display elements.
